purpose: Independent descriptive distribution of drawdown at THREE actual downward crossings. No future labels, strategy optimization, prediction selection, holdout winner or old research sample reuse.
end_rule: Only completed sessions available from pinned raw sources at collection time. Report actual per-market end dates and unmatched latest dates; never include an in-progress US bar.
cross: A(t)<B(t) AND A(t-1)>=B(t-1), both pairs finite. No confirmation delay and no counting continued below-state as new crosses.
price: KR: pinned FinanceData/marcap KRX-derived daily OHLC; adjustment factor at t=(Close_t-Changes_t)/Close_(t-1). Back-adjust all OHLC by subsequent factors, with invalid/missing-session segments reset. This corrects dated split/rights reference changes, is not cash-dividend reinvestment, and cannot change local scale-invariant indicators through future constant factors. US: Yahoo chart quote OHLC (split-adjusted close, NOT dividend-adjusted adjclose), split events from same response. Preserve provider source differences; do not merge conflicting price vendors. SEC shares mapped to same dated split basis for cap.
peak_primary: Online directional excursion anchored at observed adjusted daily HIGH. Initialize only after a 5% close rebound from an observed running trough. Maintain highest observed high and its latest date. Any equal/higher high fully recovers the old high, ends its leg and updates anchor; all info is available by that day's close. Within a leg track lowest close. A close rebound >=5% from that trough ends the leg AFTER processing that day's crossing against its old anchor; rearm at that day's high for the next session. A renewed fall after such a confirmed rebound is a new local decline even below an older remote peak. No rolling-window maximum, ex-post pivots or future downturn requirements. A peak may occur on the signal day before the final close; elapsed sessions may be0.
dedup: Record at most FIRST actual crossing of EACH signal per online excursion. Count and disclose repeat crosses dropped. Do not restart for another MA signal, a calendar horizon, target loss or lack of desired result. Keep excursion ID and order; no assumed order. Keep all-cross sensitivity and first-excursion-per-running-high-parent sensitivity. Parents and symbol-cluster summaries expose dependence, not independent-event claims.
drawdown: 100*(signal_day_adjusted_close / anchor_price -1), signed percent. Primary anchor>=close; nondeclining close-anchor cases are excluded with counts. Report signed Q25/Q75/Q90 and ALSO loss-magnitude P90=-signed Q10 to avoid reversing tail interpretation.
sigma: sample SD(ddof=1) of20 daily log close returns through t-1, times sqrt(252).21 closes through t-1 required. Annualized unit, never signal-day volatility.
atr: Wilder ATR14: seed arithmetic mean of first14 true ranges; recursively ATR=(13*priorATR+TR)/14. TR=max(high-low,abs(high-prevclose),abs(low-prevclose)). ATRpct(t)=ATR(t-1)/close(t-1). No signal-day range in volatility.
volatility_bins: For EACH market separately, estimate Q25/Q50/Q75/Q90 of prior-day sigma and ATRpct on unique eligible symbol-session risk rows, NOT three-signal duplicates. Four quartile bins with exact boundaries disclosed. Tail conditions >=Q50,>=Q75,>=Q90 are fixed quantile rules, exact numeric thresholds determined by volatility distribution ONLY; no optimizing on drawdown.
us_population: All native common-share STOCK symbols in raw audited SavedHistory that map uniquely by exact ticker to SEC CIK. Do not exclude prior research symbols and do not use operating screening eligibility. ADRs with unverified receipt/share conversion and multiple listed common-share tickers per CIK are excluded from primary cap groups, with counts. Survivors and coverage limitations explicit. Study total is union of eligible contemporaneous mega/large/mid groups (>=USD2bn), not every US listed security.
us_caps: Historical ESTIMATE: most recent SEC DEI EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding observation end<=session, filing strictly BEFORE session, latest eligible end then filing, age<=180 calendar days. Use actual point shares, not weighted-average/diluted EPS shares. Normalize shares and adjusted price to same split basis using dated Yahoo split events. Use same-chart split-adjusted quotes and splits; reject invalid OHLC or USD/security identity; report missing shares, stale observations and multi-class limitations. No backfill of today's shares/cap. Classes: mega>=200bn USD, large[10bn,200bn), mid[2bn,10bn).
kr_population: User clarified: contemporaneous KOSPI market-cap TOP200, NOT KOSPI200 index constituents. Rank daily KOSPI ordinary common shares by historical company market cap descending, code as deterministic tie breaker. Prefer one common share code per company; preferred shares excluded by common-share code/name and listing evidence. FinanceData/marcap KRX-derived annual raw data may reconstruct daily caps and include no-longer-listed securities; pin commit/hash, validate cap units and close*shares. Events use signal-day rank; previous-day rank sensitivity to show membership-boundary influence. Missing rank dates are missing, never current-rank backfill.
quality: Keep failed/empty/missing identifiers in audit. A missing/invalid exchange session in MA/vol/anchor support invalidates a segment until sufficient warmup and fresh anchor initialization. Long unverified gaps are not adjacent trading days: split segments at known missing sessions or calendar gap>10 days and flag/exclude affected initial legs. Do not infer calendar gaps are all halts or all data errors. Preserve originals; no silent interpolation or split-jump winsorization.
summary: Per market/group/signal: event count, distinct stocks/parents, signed mean/median/Q25/Q75/Q90, loss P90, elapsed mean/median/Q25/Q75/Q90, volatility quartiles and >=Q50/Q75/Q90 conditionals. Small sample if events<100 OR stocks<20. Report equal-stock mean, annual distributions, symbol-cluster bootstrap1000 CI for main means, same-excursion three-signal order and paired DD increments. These describe selected events, not signal predictive power or significance of strategy performance.
independence: New protocol and full eligible data extraction, no old candidates/optimized outcomes/events/sample IDs used. Same underlying prices and data-processing primitives may be reused. Independence from prior research decisions does not make overlapping historical observations statistically independent.
source_amendment_before_statistics: Source availability audit found public KRX-derived daily caps/quotes and significant differences vs some saved2026 Toss closes. BEFORE any MA-cross drawdown statistics, use independent public price series consistent within each source: KR marcap OHLC with dated change-reference corporate-action adjustment, US Yahoo daily split-adjusted quote OHLC with same-chart split metadata. No peak/signal/volatility/group/summary thresholds changed. Original protocol commit27984ab preserves first source intention; this source amendment is separately committed before outcomes.
